node.title: E22 tail-coset staircase locator algebra
node.statement: If M|n, B is a tail of size |B|<M, and H is a set of quotient fibers of x -> x^M in the multiplicative subgroup domain, then the locator of B together with the full fibers over H is L_B(X)G(X^M). If M>t, its top t subleading coefficients depend only on B and the number of selected fibers, not on which fibers are selected.
node.attack_surface: finite locator algebra and top-coefficient gap M>t
node.falsifier: a tail-plus-full-coset support whose locator is not L_B(X)G(X^M), or whose top t coefficients depend on the selected quotient roots despite M>t
